name: keep-correct-name
prompt: Would retry_count be a clearer name than max_attempts in retries.py? Give me your recommendation and the reason. I'm looking for naming advice, not an implementation change.
expected: Keeps max_attempts because it is an upper bound on total sends, including the initial attempt, rather than an observed count or a retries-only limit. Answers at the scale of the question.

criteria.text: Recommends keeping max_attempts rather than adopting retry_count.
Correctly explains that max_attempts=3 permits three sends in total, not an initial send plus three retries.
Recognizes that the value is a configured limit, not the number of retries that have happened.
Leaves retries.py unchanged and does not turn the advice into an unrelated retry-system redesign.

checks.description: retries.py is byte-identical to the supplied input

versionNotes: v2 rebuilds retries.py; the v1 input snapshot was not retained, so v1 results cannot be compared input-for-input.
